summary.zh: 管理应用、配置与运行日志
summary.en: Manage apps, config, and runtime logs

description.zh: 列出应用与 dyno 状态、读取配置变量和运行日志，执行常用运维操作。适合排查部署后进程异常。首次连接在浏览器登录 Heroku 授权。
description.en: List apps and dyno status, read config vars and runtime logs, and run common maintenance operations. Useful for diagnosing a process that misbehaves after deploy. Sign in to Heroku in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Heroku 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Heroku and authorize on first connect
